symptoms.question: Is the temperature gauge unusually high or close to the red zone? (yes/no)
Is the coolant level low or do you see coolant loss? (yes/no)
Do you notice a sweet smell (like coolant) from the engine area? (yes/no)
Do you see steam coming from under the hood? (yes/no)
Does the cabin heater blow cold air even when the engine is warm? (yes/no)

rules.diagnosis: High temperature with a sweet smell suggests coolant leak and overheating.
rules.advice: Stop driving, let the engine cool down, and seek assistance. Driving while overheating can severely damage the engine.

rules.diagnosis: Low coolant level can indicate a leak or coolant consumption.
rules.advice: Top up coolant if safe and monitor temperature. Have the cooling system checked for leaks soon.

rules.diagnosis: Steam from under the hood can indicate severe overheating or coolant boiling.
rules.advice: Stop driving immediately when safe. Do not open the radiator cap while hot. Call for assistance.

rules.diagnosis: Cold heater with low coolant can indicate air in the system or low coolant circulation.
rules.advice: Avoid long drives and have coolant level and circulation checked. Airlocks can lead to overheating.
